stem: After a wheat field is cleared, wild grasses and weeds begin growing. This process is considered —

options.label: F
options.text: primary succession because pioneer species appear

options.label: G
options.text: primary succession because there are no large trees

options.label: H
options.text: secondary succession because soil is already present

options.label: J
options.text: secondary succession because the field contains inorganic matter
